title: Gate 2: eight shipping checks locally and in Linux CI
summary: Stage 3 Gate 2 is complete on main 6a4fe08. The literally clean local gate passed eight files and ten tests with zero skips in 247.6 seconds, including real Mac arm64 Homebrew. Main CI run 44034847309 passed all three jobs, including actual Linuxbrew and the fresh model-assisted Gate 1 check. Reset/sync, all 16 static projects, the touched real CLI case and scoped cleanup pass. Independent review covers the identical merged tree. The historical author-rule deviation, local policy debt and one failed model sample/resample remain explicit; no public-cloud or model-reliability claim is made.
proves: A PR goes to test, then staging, then production. There is a verdict in each environment, and the npm version equals `architect version --next`.
